name: Cloudflare Bot Threat Scorer — Community Edition

parameters.content:
## 🔍 Cloudflare Bot Threat Scorer — Community Edition
**Dry-run detection and remediation recommendations.**

This workflow reads Cloudflare security events, scores hostile traffic with a transparent deterministic engine (no AI), and tells you what to block — with the evidence. **It never writes to Cloudflare and cannot block anything.** Applying blocks stays a human decision.

Automatic, TTL-managed remediation is a separate product: *Cloudflare Bot Defense Autopilot Pro*.

**Setup (once):**
1. Create an **HTTP Header Auth** credential — name `Authorization`, value `Bearer <Cloudflare API token>`. Token scopes: **Zone → Analytics : Read** and **Zone → Zone : Read**. No write scope is needed — this edition never mutates.
2. Fill the **Configuration** node (the only place to edit).
3. Wire the two `SET UP:` nodes to Slack / email / a sheet.

Built by **Cyberneticsplus** — your ally in cyber security.

### 1. One config, two triggers
Both the schedule and the manual trigger feed the single **Configuration** node — there is exactly one place to change settings.

### 2. Collect (validated query)
Discovers zones, then pulls `firewallEventsAdaptive` per zone. Every field in the query is validated against Cloudflare's live GraphQL schema.

⚠️ **Data limits — read this:**
• Only events Cloudflare's **security layer already acted on/logged** appear here — not all traffic. With no WAF/rate rules, expect few events.
• Cloudflare **adaptively samples** busy zones: counts are representative, not exhaustive.
• `limit` is capped at **10000** per query; this template pulls `eventLimitPerZone` (default 2000).
• Free/Pro plans retain roughly **24h** of events — keep `windowHours` within that.

### 3. Score (transparent, no AI)
Weighted signals: probe-path ratio, probe volume, 404 discovery, datacenter vs curated hostile ASN, UA forensics (as *suspicion* only), challenge-fail ratio, path entropy, velocity.

**No User-Agent allowlisting** — a UA is attacker-controlled and spoofable, so it can never grant a pass. The only allowlist is by **ASN** (your own networks). All weights/thresholds live in the CONFIG block at the top of this node.

### 4. Recommend — never act
`recommend_block` → a copy-paste remediation (evidence + ready-to-apply IP-List payload). **No Cloudflare API call is made anywhere in this workflow.**
`recommend_review` → human queue.
`monitor` → logged.

### 5. Wire your outputs
The two **`SET UP:`** nodes are NoOp placeholders on purpose, so the template imports with only a Cloudflare read token. Replace each with a Slack / Email / Google Sheets / SIEM node.
